title: Logarithms and Stirling numbers associated with delta series
summary: This paper investigates the Stirling numbers of the first and second kind associated with a delta series f (t). These numbers provide a robust framework that satisfies the orthogonality and inverse relations, often lacking in recent probabilistic Stirling and B-Stirling numbers. Key contributions include the definition and analysis of the logarithm associated with a delta series f (t). We further establish a Schlomilch-type formula, which provides an explicit connection between the two kinds of Stirling numbers.
